俺と武たちはガレムグラード山脈の奥に立地している、\n研究所へと向かって森の中を:
Takeru and the others were with me as we made our way through the forest,
heading for a research lab deep in the Garemgrad Mountains.
そこ気を付けてね。\n根っこが飛び出してるから、足を取られやすいよ。:
Careful there.
Those roots are sticking out. It's easy to trip.
ええ、分かったわ。\n……しかし、本当に道なき道を進んでいるわね。:
Yes, understood.
...We really are making our own trail, aren't we?
まあ、ガレムグラード山脈は広大だし……メイズの入口も\n近いから、大半のエリアは:
Well, the Garemgrad Mountains are vast... And with a Maze entrance
nearby, most of the area is apparently untouched.
研究所の周辺は険しいってだけで、普通に登山できるレベルだと\n聞いたぞ。なんなら:
I heard the terrain around the lab was rough, but nothing beyond an ordinary hike.
Besides, I went up to the snowy part of the mountains recently.
だいぶ標高の高いところもあるんだな。\nこの山だけでも歯ごたえありまくりの訓練フ:
So there are some pretty high elevations too.
This mountain alone would make one tough training ground.
そうだねー。このあたりでサバイバル訓練するのもいいかもね。: Yeah. This might be a good place for survival training.
まずは生徒会長さんに相談じゃない？勝手に使うわけにはいかないだろうし。: Shouldn't we ask the Student Council President first? We can't just use it without permission.
そんな会話をしながら進んでいく中で、\nふと鎧衣さんが疑問の声を上げる。:
As we chatted and pressed on,
Yoroi-san suddenly spoke up.
……んー、やっぱり道路の痕跡もないし、獣道すら無いよ。: ...Hmm. There's still no sign of a road. Not even an animal trail.
そりゃ不思議だな。\n人が居ないなら獣道くらいは出来てそうなもんだが。:
That's strange.
Even without people around, you'd expect some animal trails.
野生動物でも寄り付かないところがないわけじゃないけど、\nそれはだいたい人間がい:
There are places even wild animals won't go,
but usually that's because there are people there.
原因はわからないけど、動物も寄り付かない変な場所ってことは\nわかったってところ:
We don't know why, but at least we know this place is strange enough
to keep the animals away. I wonder if we'll find a path?
大きい動物がいないのは助かる。: No large animals. That's a relief.
そうね。大きいのも厄介だけど、蛇や蜘蛛みたいに小さくても、\n毒持ちの生き物がい:
Yes. Large animals are trouble, but small ones like snakes and spiders
could still be venomous, so let's stay alert.
……そう言いながら周囲の確認をサクサクと済ませて、\nドンドンと山を切り開いて進:
...Even as she spoke, she quickly checked our surroundings,
then kept clearing a way through the mountains.
大変だとは言うが、鎧衣さんのペースは下手をすれば、\n整備された山道を歩く俺より:
She said it was hard going, but Yoroi-san might have been moving
more smoothly than I would on a proper mountain path.
……なんというか、慣れてるな。\n俺だけだったら、流石にそんな風に森を抜けれなか:
...You really know your way around this.
I couldn't have gotten through the forest like that on my own.
あはは、まあそこは慣れかなー。今のところ高い崖とか大きな川とか、\n進むのに苦労:
Ahaha. Well, it's just practice. We haven't run into any high cliffs or big rivers
that would make things difficult yet, so it's still pretty easy.
サバイバルはホント美琴の右に出る奴はいないよなあ。\nたしか、衛士の訓練課程にも:
Nobody beats Mikoto when it comes to survival.
I think I remember survival training being part of the Surface Pilot course, too.
そうね、すごーく大変だった印象ね。詳しいところは覚えてないけど。: Yes. I remember it being really tough, though I can't recall the details.
みんなで協力して乗り越えたんだよ！ だって衛士になれたわけだし。: We got through it by working together! We became Surface Pilots, after all.
う～ん、なんか途中でケンカしてヤバかったような覚えもあるなあ……: Hmm... I seem to remember us having a fight along the way. Things got pretty ugly...
やはり思い出そうとしても、中々思い出せないらしい。\n俺も同じような状態ではある:
It seemed they still couldn't recall much, even when they tried.
I knew how that felt. I was in much the same situation.
やっぱり靄がかかったみたいに、細かいところはさっぱりなのよね……: It's like everything's covered in fog. The details just won't come back...
思い出せないものはしょうがないよ。また何かのきっかけで、\n出てくるかもしれない:
If we can't remember, we can't remember. Something might jog our memories
later, so let's take it slow. ...Oh, right.
%usernameusernameuserna%さん、\nせっかくならこっちの世:
%usernameusernameuserna%-san,
while we're here, can I ask you about this world?
こっちの世界の話か……\nたとえば、どんなのがいいんだ？:
This world, huh...
What sort of things do you want to know?
んー、そうだなぁ……探してるのが研究所だし、\nこっちの世界ではどんなことを研究:
Hmm, let's see... Since we're looking for a research lab,
maybe what kind of research people do here?
そうね……ＭＧのことはもっとよく知っておきたいわね。\n戦術機とすごく良く似てる:
Yes... I'd like to know more about MGs.
They're very similar to Tactical Surface Fighters, but there seem to be quite a few differences.
武装もけっこう違う。: The weapons are pretty different too.
おいおい、そんなに質問を一気にしたら、\n%usernameusernameus:
Hey, if you ask everything at once,
you'll overwhelm %usernameusernameuserna%.
気にすんなって。ゆっくり答えてくれればいいさ。\nオレもいろいろ聞かせてもらうぜ:
Don't worry about it. Take your time answering.
I'd like to hear about it too, you know?
しかし、確かにただ黙々と探索をするというのも、\n気分が落ち込んで気力も削れてし:
Still, searching in silence would only dampen our spirits
and wear us down. It wasn't a bad topic to pass the time.
そうだな……まず、こっちの研究はメイズが中心だな。\n俺も記憶がなかったんだが…:
Let's see... Most research here revolves around the Maze.
I'd lost my memories too, but... Hearing about Maze studies really surprised me.
学問になるほど研究が盛んなのね。\nまあ、メイズが中心にならざるを得ない社会なん:
So there's enough research to make it an academic discipline.
Well, with a society that has to revolve around the Maze, I suppose that's natural.
いや、俺もそんなに知ってることが多くはないから何ともだな。\nけっこう細かく分野:
I can't really say. I don't know that much about it myself.
Apparently, there are quite a few specialized fields.
ザルトゥーム学園にはパイロット科以外にもいろいろな学科があって、\nメイズ関連の:
Zartum Academy has all sorts of departments besides pilot training,
and there seem to be particularly many Maze-related majors.
メイズ探索の最前線だけあって充実してるんだね。: It really is well equipped, being on the front line of Maze exploration.
もしかしなくても、桃園さん達ってかなり優秀なのかしら？ その割には\nだいぶ謙虚:
So Momozono-san and the others must be pretty talented, mustn't they? Though
for all that, they seemed rather modest... Or not very confident, I suppose.
まあ、める達はつい最近まではパイロット科の中でも\n落第寸前だったからな……他の:
Well, until just recently, Meru and the others
were on the verge of failing out of pilot training... The others are quite a bunch of characters, too.
ああ。例えば、メイズ研究が趣味で地頭はいいんだが、たびたび\n怪しい実験をしてい:
Yeah. One's really smart and studies the Maze as a hobby, but she's always
running dubious experiments. Sometimes she even blows up the clubroom.
……大丈夫なのかそれ？ いや、大丈夫じゃないな。: ...Is that really okay? No, of course it isn't.
退学寸前まで追い込まれたこともあったなぁ。\n今はわりかし落ち着いてるみたいだが:
She was nearly expelled once.
She seems to have settled down a bit now, though.
退学にしたほうがよかったんじゃないかしら……: Perhaps they should have expelled her...
学校を爆破しても許されるってスゴイね……: They let you stay even after blowing up the school? Wow...
（……ドン引きされたな。\nいやまあ、冷静に考えると結構ヤバいことしてるんだよな:
(...That really put them off.
Well, when you stop and think about it, Chiyuru does some pretty outrageous things.)
と、何故か首をかしげている武。: For some reason, Takeru was tilting his head.
いや……なんか懐かしいな～って。そういうヤバめな人が\n知り合いにいたような…。:
Well... It feels kind of familiar. I think I knew someone
that dangerous... Someone older, maybe.
年上で実験するような仕事をしてて、\n爆発させることもしばしば……科学者あがりの:
Someone older who worked on experiments,
and blew things up now and then... A scientist turned terrorist?
そんな人いたかなあ？\nボクたち軍人だったみたいだから、爆発は慣れっこだったと思:
Did we know anyone like that?
We seem to have been soldiers, so I imagine we were used to explosions...
そうね、そんな頭のおかしい悪の科学者みたいな人はいなかったと思うわ。: Yes. I don't think we knew anyone like some deranged evil scientist.
私も知らない。いたら全力で逃げてる。: Me neither. If we did, I'd run for my life.
３人とは対照的に、武は未だに眉間に皺を寄せていた。: Unlike the ３ of them, Takeru was still frowning.
爆破とまではいかないけど……\nかなり変わり者の博士っぽいのがいた気がするんだよ:
Maybe not someone who blew things up...
But I feel like there was a pretty eccentric scientist...
白銀。そろそろ目標座標のあたりよ。\nこの話はいったん終わりにしましょう。:
Shirogane. We're getting close to the target coordinates.
Let's leave this discussion for now.
おお、すまん。了解だ。\n純夏、すぐに助けてやるからな…。:
Oh, sorry. Roger.
Sumika, I'll get you out soon...
木立を抜けた先、それなりに見晴らしの効く場所に出た。\nそこが目標座標のはずだが:
We emerged from the trees into a place with a fairly clear view.
We should have been at the target coordinates, but there was no sign of the lab.
端末では指定座標と私たちの位置情報がちゃんと一致してるわよ！\nおかしいわね…。:
Our position matches the designated coordinates on my terminal!
That's strange...
近くをざっと探ってみるものの、建物の類は見つからない。: We had a quick look around, but couldn't find any buildings.
どうなってるんだ……？情報が間違ってたっていうのか？: What's going on...? Was the information wrong?
その可能性はあるよね。そもそも研究所が出来たときに、登録された\n住所情報が間違:
That's possible. Maybe the address was registered incorrectly
when the lab was built, or they deliberately left out the right one.
でも、その可能性を言い始めると探索範囲が広がりすぎるわ。\n……最悪、出直す可能:
But if we start considering that, our search area gets far too large.
...Worst case, we might have to come back another time...
……いや、ダメだ。\nここにくる手間を考えると、今見つけないと時間が足りない。:
...No. We can't.
It took too long to get here. If we don't find it now, we won't have enough time.
そうだな。とにかく周囲を見て回ろう。\nもしかしたら、すぐに見つかる可能性も……:
Right. Let's look around, anyway.
We might find it sooner than we think...
鎧衣さんの言葉に振り向き……バランスを崩した俺は、\nそのまま転落しそうになる。:
I turned at Yoroi-san's warning... and lost my balance,
nearly tumbling down.
反射的に周りの木を掴むも、小枝のように細く身体を支えきれない。\n滑り落ちること:
I grabbed a nearby tree on instinct, but it was too thin to hold my weight.
Just as I braced myself for the fall, Takeru caught my arm and stopped me.
あ、ああ……大丈夫だ……すまん、油断してた。: Y-yeah... I'm okay... Sorry, I let my guard down.
ごめんね。\n細い木がいっぱいで、気づくのが遅れちゃった。:
Sorry.
All those thin trees made it hard to notice in time.
ここから落ちたら危なかったね。\nそうしたら研究所捜索どころじゃなかったよ。:
Falling from here would've been bad.
We'd have had bigger problems than finding the lab.
行き止まりか……クソ、一刻も早く見つけなきゃいけないってのによ！: A dead end... Damn it, we need to find it as soon as possible!
……もしかしたら、崖の下にあったりする？: ...Could it be down at the bottom of the cliff?
ここまで建物の痕跡もなかったし、もし本当に研究所があるとしたら、\n崖下に作って:
We haven't found any trace of a building. If the lab really is here,
maybe they built it below the cliff to make it harder to find...
……なるほど、その可能性に賭けましょうか。\n全員、注目！:
...I see. Let's take a chance on that.
Everyone, listen up!
これより、崖下に研究所があるという前提で捜索するわ！\n鎧衣、彩峰は先行してロー:
We'll search on the assumption that the lab is below this cliff!
Yoroi, Ayamine, go ahead and rappel down!
私と白銀、指揮官さんは、\nふたりが下に着くまで周囲を警戒して安全を確保！:
Shirogane, the Commander and I
will keep watch and secure the area until those two reach the bottom!
方針を明確にした榊さんの指示によって、\nそれぞれが各々の指示された役割を全うす:
With Sakaki-san's clear plan and instructions,
everyone set about their assigned tasks.
チームの中心は御剣さんや武のように見えるが……\n榊さんが隊長である理由がよく分:
Mitsurugi-san and Takeru might seem like the heart of the team...
But now I could see why Sakaki-san was their squad leader.
冷静さと判断力、そしてその的確な指示。\nこれらは、確かに榊さんでなければ出せな:
Her composure, her judgment, and those precise orders.
It was clear that only Sakaki-san could have led them like that.
――支点構築完了。ロープ異常なし。\nうん、こっちはいいよ。:
—Anchor secured. Rope checked.
Yep, all good here.
……周辺に異常もない。降りて大丈夫。: ...Nothing unusual in the area. It's safe to go down.
了解！ ……それじゃあ、全員降下しましょうか。\n指揮官さんは、手伝いは居る？:
Roger! ...All right, let's all descend.
Commander, do you need any help?
いや、大丈夫だ。俺も教導指揮官をしてる立場だからな……\n助けてもらってばかりじ:
No, I'm fine. I'm an Instructional Commander, after all...
It wouldn't look good if I kept relying on you for help, would it?
軽口を叩きながら、鎧衣さんがかけたロープを使って降り、\nついに隠れていた研究所:
With that little joke, I descended the rope Yoroi-san had set up,
and at last, we reached the hidden research lab.
